wiki_item_placeholder: Search items or type a Q number
topbar_add_point_hint: Add a point: click the map to place it
topbar_draw_line_hint: Draw a line: click for every node, Enter or a click on the last node finishes
topbar_draw_area_hint: Draw an area: click for every node, Enter or a click on the first node finishes
topbar_server_edits_hint: Save or undo your edits first. The server cannot change while there are unsaved edits.
picker_category_expand: Show the feature types in this category
picker_category_collapse: Hide the feature types in this category
favourites_button_hint: Favourites: hold {key} and type a number to start one
favourites_intro: Hold {key} and type a number to start a favourite. Numbers 1–3 are the point, line and area keys.
favourites_empty: You have no favourites yet. Add one with the star next to a feature type in the type search.
sidebar_empty_hint: Click a feature on the map to see and edit its tags.
rotate_point_description: Adjust this point's numeric direction tag.
direction_rotate_hint: Press {key} to adjust this value on the map.
search_input_label: Search for coordinates, an OSM id, a name on the map or a place
search_hint: Type coordinates such as 52.5, 13.4 or 17/52.5/13.4, an OSM id such as w123, a link to the map, or a name on the map. Press Enter to search places.
search_object_not_loaded_hint: Move the map to it first
search_places_failed: The place search failed. Try again.
search_follow_background: Not following: the map was moved
search_follow_error: Your location could not be found
turn_restrictions_help_click: Click a turn to change it: allowed, no turn, or only this turn.
turn_restrictions_distance_tip: How far from the junction the search for connected roads goes.
turn_restrictions_via_tip: How many ways a restriction may pass through; node only is the simplest, and simple is better.
turn_restrictions_not_junction: The roads here do not make a junction where turns can be restricted.
turn_restrictions_indirect_hint: Indirect: caused by a nearby restriction. Change the direct restriction next to it.
turn_restrictions_rule_label: Turn restriction without its from, via and to members
turn_restrictions_rule_message: The turn restriction is incomplete: it needs one from way, one via node or way, and one to way
issues_session_notice: Showing issues in existing data too
issues_empty_quiet: No issues in what you changed. Features you select are checked too; their issues in existing data stay quiet.
issues_empty_session: No issues in what you changed or selected.
relations_zoom_members_tip: Zoom the map to the members of this relation
relations_gap_title: The ends of these two ways do not meet
relations_load_nothing_one: Loaded nothing: the missing member is not in the API.
relations_load_nothing_other: Loaded nothing: {count} members are not in the API.
relations_load_partial_one: Loaded {added}; the other member is not in the API.
relations_load_partial_other: Loaded {added}; {count} members are not in the API.
relations_placed_between: Added as member {index} of {count}, between {before} and {after}
relations_placed_start: Added as member {index} of {count}, at the start
relations_placed_end: Added as member {index} of {count}, at the end
relations_hint_restriction: Deleting this way breaks the turn restriction
relations_hint_outer: Deleting this way removes an outer ring of the multipolygon
relations_reason_invalid: Not allowed in this type of relation
relations_none_of_selected: None of the selected features is in a relation.
relations_locked_hint: Read-only features cannot change their relations.
relations_op_add_reason: Choose a relation in the sidebar
relations_op_remove_several: The features are in several relations: remove them in the Relations section
map_display_edits_hint: Created and changed features in colour.
traffic_sign_empty: No signs yet. Search below by name or sign ID to add one.
traffic_sign_no_results: No sign matches. Press Enter to add the text as it is.
traffic_sign_more_results: {count} more, keep typing to narrow down
relations_column_fit: Fit the members in the map
relations_column_show_relation: Show the tags of the relation
paste_tags_merge_hint: The copied tags are added. A key they share with the feature takes the copied value; its other tags stay.
paste_tags_replace_hint: The feature gets exactly the copied tags. Its other tags are removed.
paste_tags_refused: The tags could not be pasted: a feature is read-only or gone.
route_overview_issue_gap_text: The two ways around this point do not meet. They are {distance} m apart.
route_overview_issue_gap_todo: Look for a missing way and add it to the relation, or connect the ends on the map.
route_overview_issue_order_text: The ways form one line, but the relation lists {moved} of them in a different order. The overview shows the order of the line.
route_overview_issue_order_todo: Sort the members in the relation so that they follow the line.
route_overview_issue_not_loaded_text: {count} members are not in the data that is loaded. The overview cannot place them.
route_overview_issue_not_loaded_todo: Load the members with the download button in the member list.
route_overview_issue_point_far_text: This point is {distance} m from the line.
route_overview_issue_point_far_todo: Check that it is the right object, or move it next to the route.
route_overview_issue_out_of_sequence_tex: This stop comes earlier on the line than the one listed before it.
route_overview_issue_out_of_sequence_tod: Move it in the member list to the place where the route passes it.
route_overview_issue_junction_without_gu: Here {ways} other ways meet the route, and no guidepost member is near.
If there is a guidepost, add it to the relation. If not, you can ignore this.
route_overview_issue_no_guideposts_text: This route lists no guidepost at all, so the overview does not hint at junctions without one.
route_overview_issue_no_guideposts_todo: Add the guideposts along the route, if you know them. This is only a hint.
route_overview_issue_unknown_role_text: The role “{role}” is not one the overview knows, so the member is listed apart from the line.
route_overview_issue_unknown_role_todo: Check the spelling of the role, or set the right one.
route_overview_issue_branch_detached_tex: This side line touches the main line nowhere.
route_overview_issue_branch_detached_tod: Connect it to the main line on the map, or check its role.
route_overview_issue_duplicate_text: The same member with the same role comes twice in a row.
route_overview_issue_empty_text: No main way of this route is loaded, so there is no line to draw.
route_overview_issue_empty_todo: Load the members with the download button in the member list.
